findings.rationale: The proposed discriminator is the source's feature-value contrast: Iris represented/present in Alder versus absent in Basin. Feature records exist for both Alder and Basin, so this predicate does not discriminate the positive case from the tolerated control and can change a discriminator hard-gate result.
